items.source: Select and return the names of which class(es) should be imported based on the AnnotationMetadata of the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 AnnotationMetadata 类，选择并返回应导入的类名。

items.source: An ImportSelector may implement any of the following Aware interfaces, and their respective methods will be called prior to selectImports(AnnotationMetadata):
items.translation: `ImportSelector` 可以实现以下任意一个 `Aware` 接口， 并且它们相应的方法将在调用 `selectImports(AnnotationMetadata)` 之前被调用：

items.source: ImportSelector implementations are usually processed in the same way as regular @Import annotations, however, it is also possible to defer selection of imports until all @Configuration classes have been processed (see DeferredImportSelector for details).
items.translation: `ImportSelector` 实现通常与常规 `@Import` 注解的处理方式相同，但也可以推迟导入项的选择，直到所有 `@Configuration` 类都已处理完毕（有关详细信息，请参阅 DeferredImportSelector）。

items.source: If this predicate returns true for a given fully-qualified class name, said class will not be considered as an imported configuration class, bypassing class file loading as well as metadata introspection.
items.translation: 如果该谓词对给定的完全限定类名返回 `true`，则该类的导入配置将不被考虑，同时也会跳过类文件加载以及元数据检查。

items.source: the filter predicate for fully-qualified candidate class names of transitively imported configuration classes, or null if none
items.translation: 用于跨级导入的配置类的完全限定候选类名称的过滤器谓词，或者如果没有则为 `null`。

items.source:
Alternatively, the class may provide a single constructor with one or more of
the following supported parameter types:
items.translation: 或者，该类可以提供一个构造函数，包含以下支持的一个或多个参数类型：

items.source:
Return a predicate for excluding classes from the import candidates, to be
transitively applied to all classes found through this selector's imports.
items.translation: 返回一个谓词，用于从导入候选项中排除类，该谓词将递归应用于通过此选择器的导入发现的所有类。

items.source: the class names, or an empty array if none
items.translation: 类名，或如果没有则为空数组
